entry.summary: Application for interim relief under s 15 of the Judicial Review Procedure Act 2016 declined. Held: applicant could not show it had a position that was necessary to preserve when the granting of interim relief would have involved preventing the Minister from implementing a broad public policy setting. Discretionary factors more broadly also weighed against the granting of interim relief.
